issue.title: Automate Project 4 ticket lifecycle (In Progress → In PR Review → In QA / Done)
issue.body:
## Summary

Ticket Status on Project 4 is supposed to move with delivery, but agents and CI do it inconsistently. Fix the lifecycle so Status tracks the work automatically:

1. **`/start-issue`** → **In Progress (Dev)**
2. **PR opened** (`/create-pr`) → **In PR Review**
3. **Merged + Needs QA? Yes** → **In QA** (existing handoff; keep/harden)
4. **Merged + Needs QA? No** (engineering-only) → **Done** + **close** the linked GitHub issue

Needs-QA tickets still stay open after merge until human/QA sets **Passed QA** / **Done**.

## Problem

- `/start-issue` documents the In Progress move but the mutation is incomplete / fragile (inline GraphQL snippets).
- `/create-pr` has a best-effort In PR Review move that often fails or is skipped.
- Post-merge automation only handles **Needs QA? Yes** → In QA.
- Engineering-only merges leave cards stuck in **In PR Review** with open issues forever (docs currently say never auto-close).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Shared Project 4 helper (IDs + move/add helpers) used by CI and agent commands — no duplicated fragile GraphQL in command markdown.
- [ ] CLI agents can run for `In Progress (Dev)` and `In PR Review` (add to Project 4 if missing; never move Product-owned columns).
- [ ] `/start-issue` and `/create-pr` call that CLI (best-effort warn-and-continue).
- [ ] On merge: **Needs QA? Yes** → existing QA handoff (comment, assign `@Roslin22`, **In QA**).
- [ ] On merge: **Needs QA? No** explicitly checked → linked `Refs #NNN` issues → Project 4 **Done** + close issue (`completed`) with a short bot comment. Soft-fail board/close failures.
- [ ] Still never use `Closes` / `Fixes` / `Resolves` in PR bodies — close only via post-merge automation for engineering-only.
- [ ] Docs/rules updated: `project-board.md`, `qa-process.md`, `issue-tracking.md`, `delivery.mdc` / `project-board.mdc`.
- [ ] Unit tests for Needs QA? No detection + Done/close path.

## Out of scope

- Auto-closing Needs-QA tickets on merge
- Auto-moving **Passed QA** / release columns
- Board sweeps or Product-column edits

## File pointers

- `.claude/commands/start-issue.md`, `.claude/commands/create-pr.md`
- `.github/workflows/qa-handoff.yml`, `.github/scripts/qa-handoff-on-merge.cjs`
- `.github/scripts/preview-notify-linked-issues.cjs`
- `docs/guides/project-board.md`, `docs/guides/qa-process.md`, `docs/issue-tracking.md`
